application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of a Basement Impact Assessment pursuant to condition 5 of planning permission ref: 250363HH dated 09/05/2025 for: Excavation to provide extension to basement with lightwells to front and side (following demolition of existing basement); single storey rear extension (following demolition of existing rear addition); replacement of existing dormer roof window to elevation b (following demolition of existing dormer roof window); replacement of all single-glazed windows with timber-frame, double-glazed conservation-style windows; replacement of the timber boundary fence in the rear garden; installation of PV solar panels; installation of air conditioning unit to elevation B flat roof;  alterations to elevation C fenestrations involving removal of rooflights, installation of two rooflights; alterations to existing roof to elevation C; construction of timber bin store to front garden; associated external and internal alterations
